summary: Vylor Inc. filed an 8-K reporting completion of its separation from Corteva, Inc., effected at 12:03 a.m. New York time on October 1, 2026 via a pro rata distribution of all Vylor common shares to Corteva holders of record as of September 24, 2026; Vylor common stock began regular-way NYSE trading under VYLR on October 1. Ancillary agreements include Separation and Distribution, Tax Matters, Employee Matters, Transition Services, Intellectual Property Matters, and Global Master Seed Treatment Supply. No price, premium, or board recommendation is stated; distribution ratio and trading level will drive the arbitrage angle.
